meta.name: add-anydoc
meta.description: Add local office-document-to-Markdown conversion to NanoClaw agent containers with the pinned Firecrawl AnyDoc CLI. Use when agents need to read attached Word, PowerPoint, Excel, OpenDocument, RTF, EPUB, CSV, or text-based PDF files without uploading them to a hosted parser.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让你的智能助手直接读懂本地各类办公文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你的智能助手需要读取本地办公文档却不便上传到云端
copy.tagline_en: Let your AI agent read local office documents directly
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your AI agent to read local office docs without uploading them.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会在 NanoClaw agent 容器内用固定版本的 Firecrawl AnyDoc CLI,把本地的 Word、Excel、PowerPoint 等附件转成 Markdown,不经过托管解析器,也不需要凭据或 MCP 服务。
howto.when: 当 agent 需要读取附件里的 Word、PowerPoint、Excel 等文档,又不想把它们上传到托管解析器时触发;它只负责把文档在本地转成 Markdown,不改变 NanoClaw 原有的附件流程。

say.text: 把附件里的 DOCX 转成 Markdown,再总结相关段落
把这份 XLSX 转成 Markdown,输出到 converted 目录
say.note: 表格 Markdown 不作为计算结果的依据

say.text: 这份纯图片 PDF 能转成 Markdown 吗?
say.note: 纯图片 PDF 会明确报错,不会被上传

howto.what_en: With this installed, Claude converts local Word, Excel, PowerPoint and similar attachments to Markdown inside the NanoClaw agent container using a pinned Firecrawl AnyDoc CLI, without a hosted parser, credentials, or an MCP server.
howto.when_en: Triggers when an agent must read attached Word, PowerPoint, Excel and other Office files without uploading them to a hosted parser; it only handles local document conversion.

say_en.text: Convert this DOCX attachment to Markdown and summarize the relevant sections
Use anydoc to convert this XLSX to Markdown in the converted folder
say_en.note: Spreadsheet Markdown is not authoritative for calculations

say_en.text: Can this image-only PDF be converted?
say_en.note: Image-only PDFs fail clearly and are never uploaded
